summary: Iteration 2 validated the three new features on HealthTwin.AI (password reset, doctor invite, PDF export). Backend: all endpoints working — password-reset/request returns 200 with inline reset_token, password-reset/confirm updates password (verified by subsequent login with new password), doctor invite-patient creates account + returns temp_password (verified: doctor/admin only), /api/reports/risk-pdf?auth=<jwt> returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/pdf and %PDF- header (4170 bytes). Frontend: /login has link-forgot → /reset-password, reset flow advances stages, token pre-fills, redirects to /login, new password login succeeds. Doctor invite modal (open-invite-btn → invite-patient-modal → invite-name/email/submit) works and displays temp_password in invite-result. Invited patient can log in immediately with the temp password. Both patient-download-pdf-btn and doctor-download-pdf-btn (via patient detail Open) are present with correct data-testids. ISSUE: Clicking patient-download-pdf-btn fires NO network request or download in Chromium — the downloadRiskPdf() helper creates a detached <a> element and calls click() without appending to document.body, which is unreliable in modern browsers. Same code pattern exists in DoctorDashboard.jsx.

Frontend /login shows Forgot password link (data-testid=link-forgot) navigating to /reset-password
ResetPassword page: reset-email + reset-request-btn → token auto-fills into reset-token; reset-new-password + reset-confirm-btn → redirect to /login
Login with newly-set password lands on /patient dashboard
Doctor login → /doctor patient roster with data-testid=open-invite-btn visible

Invited patient can log in with the temp password (redirects to /patient)
data-testid=patient-download-pdf-btn present in patient dashboard header
data-testid=doctor-download-pdf-btn present in doctor patient detail view (after clicking Open on a roster row)

failed.issue: Clicking data-testid=patient-download-pdf-btn triggers NO network request to /api/reports/risk-pdf and no browser download event fires. Verified by capturing page.on('request'), page.on('response'), and page.on('download') for 6s after click.
failed.evidence: /app/frontend/src/pages/PatientDashboard.jsx lines 16-23: downloadRiskPdf() creates `const a = document.createElement('a')`, sets href/download, then calls `a.click()` WITHOUT appending to document.body. Detached anchor click() is unreliable and often ignored by Chromium for download intents. Same pattern exists in DoctorDashboard.jsx (lines 17-23) so doctor PDF download likely has the same defect (button presence verified, click behavior not exercised).

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/PatientDashboard.jsx (downloadRiskPdf) and /app/frontend/src/pages/DoctorDashboard.jsx (downloadRiskPdf): append the anchor to document.body before .click() and remove it afterwards, e.g. `document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();`. Alternatively use `window.open(url, '_blank')`. Backend endpoint itself is 100% working (verified via curl: HTTP 200, application/pdf, %PDF- header).
